description: This file contains functions and types related to managing allowlists, room matching, group policies, and mention gating for Nextcloud Talk integration, including normalization, matching, and policy evaluation logic.

methods.name: normalizeAllowEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string by trimming, converting to lowercase, and removing specific prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeNextcloudTalkAllowlist
methods.description: Converts an array of strings or numbers into a normalized string array, filtering out empty values.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Determines if a sender is allowed based on the allowlist, returning match details.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkRoomMatch
methods.description: Finds and returns the matching room configuration and access decision based on a room token.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the group tool policy configuration for a given group context.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a mention is required based on room or wildcard configuration.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkGroupAllow
methods.description: Evaluates if a group is allowed based on group policy and allowlists.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkMentionGate
methods.description: Determines if mention gating should be skipped or bypassed based on parameters.
